description: This file is a shell script intended for testing Git-SVN integration, specifically verifying the initial main branch naming convention when using standard layout in a Subversion repository. It sets up a test repository, imports directories as SVN paths, performs a git svn clone, and verifies the branch setup.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: Runs SVN commands used for repository setup.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
